capabilities: Export dated tasks from the current note to an .ics file
Open the generated .ics with the system calendar app
Parse Tasks emoji dates, reminder syntax, and Dataview date fields
Configure timezone, event duration, and VALARM reminders
Deduplicate re-exported events via stable UIDs
extras: iOS support is incomplete (uses openWithDefaultApp, which iOS Obsidian does not expose; tracked in Issues). README says the plugin is 'once published' to community plugins and the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Recurring events (RRULE) are not supported yet.
problem: Dated tasks in Obsidian can't reach calendar apps like Google Calendar or Outlook without manual re-entry or whole-vault subscription plugins.
summary: Task exporter that turns dated tasks in the current note into an .ics calendar file and opens it with the system calendar app.
